findings.passage: “We need to make the voting process easy,” Jones said.
findings.note: Dallas Voice quotes him from his House District 100 runoff campaign. In the same article he is reported to favor same-day voter registration, longer voting hours, more poll staff and easier mail voting. The reporter paraphrased those points; only the quoted sentence is his own wording.

findings.motion: SJR 37 passed to third reading, Record 1897 (98 yeas, 18 nays)
findings.note: SJR 37 proposes a constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen. He is listed among the nays (Jones, V.).
subjects: proof of citizenship to vote (constitutional amendment SJR 37)
